findings.title: Oversize path destroys the request after responding, which can emit an unhandled stream error
findings.evidence: On the oversized-body path, the middleware sends a 413 and then calls 'req.destroy()' while its 'error' handler immediately returns once 'settled' is true, so the destroy-triggered request error is not forwarded or consumed by this middleware.
findings.recommendation: Do not destroy the request this way after sending the 413, or explicitly consume/handle the resulting stream error. A safer pattern is to unpipe/stop reading and let the server close the connection cleanly, or attach an error handler that still consumes the destroy-induced error after 'settled' is set.
